Private candidate successor 29aa08234ea7ec41436e626c39afac3f2be9572d replaces that transmute with public ThreadId Hash selection among the same immutable regex clones; the archive preimage is retained separately. Independent counter review and actual guarded Original comparisons are in program/evidence/CORE01-tokenizer-independent-a2: 26,414 counts with no differences, all scalar values for eight Unicode categories equal, 4,096 concurrent counts, and a compiled special-token negative control. This proves a bounded ordinary-string counter profile. Production callers, release/Wasm builds, arbitrary size and the full CORE gate remain unverified. The program reuse audit remains pending; this private stage does not adopt the module into integration.
